preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the array must be between 1 and n.
The length of the array a must be equal to n.

postconditions.description: Each output value d_i must be either a non-negative integer or -1.

postconditions.expression: all(d_i == -1 or d_i >= 1 for d_i in d)
postconditions.description: If d_i is not -1, it must be at least 1, indicating a valid number of moves.

postconditions.expression: all(d_i == -1 or (a[i] % 2 != a[j] % 2 for j in range(n) if d[i] == 1 and a[j] % 2 != a[i] % 2))
postconditions.description: If d_i is 1, there must exist at least one position j with opposite parity to a_i.
